test_download_timeout_retry_loop: test the download retry loop with exponential backoff sleep on TooManyRequests errors
test_download_failed_retry_loop: test the download retry loop without sleep on DownloadFailed errors
test_download_cache_hit: test that repeated downloads with matching SHA256 checksum reuse cached data
test_download_mismatched_checksum: test that a mismatched SHA256 checksum raises a DownloadFailed error
test_download_no_urls: test that calling download with an empty URL list raises a ValueError
